description: Configurator core module — control plane for tenant registry, module enablement, feature flag overrides, module configuration, and integration profiles. Module/feature registry data is owned by Master Data; the Configurator maintains local read projections synced via events. See 01-schema-design.md for rationale.

organizations.description: Parent entities that own one or more tenants. Hospital chains, medical colleges, standalone hospitals, government networks.

contact_email.description: Primary contact email for the organization

metadata.description: Flexible org-level metadata (regulatory registration IDs, logo URLs, etc.)

created_by.description: Platform operator who created this organization

indexes.name: idx_organizations_slug
indexes.note: Slug lookup for URL routing

indexes.name: idx_organizations_status
indexes.note: Filter active organizations in admin listing

tenants.description: Tenant registry. Each row represents a hospital/facility deployment. Few rows total, queried by every module for tenant context.

iq_tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier — used as the distribution key in all other module schemas

parent_tenant_id.description: Parent tenant within the same org. NULL = root-level tenant. Self-reference to tenants.iq_tenant_id. Organizational metadata only — no config inheritance, no access propagation, no decommissioning cascade.

name.description: Tenant display name (e.g., AIIMS Delhi, Apollo Chennai)

type.description: Deployment model. fragmented = subset of modules, co-existing with legacy systems (the primary adoption model per ADR-0002).

provisioning_status.description: Lifecycle state. Transitions: provisioning→active, active→suspended, suspended→active, active→decommissioned, suspended→decommissioned.

data_isolation_level.description: Controls Citus shard placement. shared = co-located with other tenants. isolated = dedicated hardware. Module code is identical either way.

cerbos_scope_key.description: Scope identifier for Cerbos tenant-specific policy overrides. Published to the Cerbos policy deployment pipeline.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for this tenant

locale.description: Default locale for this tenant (BCP 47 tag)

metadata.description: Tenant-level metadata (branding colors, logo URL, regulatory flags, NABH accreditation status)

created_by.description: Platform operator who provisioned this tenant

indexes.name: idx_tenants_slug
indexes.note: Slug lookup for URL routing and tenant resolution

indexes.name: idx_tenants_org
indexes.note: List all tenants for an organization

indexes.name: idx_tenants_parent
indexes.note: List child tenants of a parent (tree view in admin UI)

indexes.name: idx_tenants_status
indexes.note: Filter active tenants

indexes.name: idx_tenants_cerbos_scope
indexes.note: Resolve tenant from Cerbos scope key

module_projection.description: Local read projection of Master Data's modules table. Synced via module.registered and module.updated events. The Configurator never queries master_data.modules directly.

id.description: Module ID — matches master_data.modules.id (preserved from event payload)

name.description: Machine-readable module name (e.g., opd, pharmacy, user_management)

display_name.description: Human-readable module name for admin UI

category.description: Module classification for admin UI grouping

is_core.description: True for the 4 core modules. Used by provisioning to seed tenant_modules.

synced_at.description: When this projection was last synced from a Master Data event

indexes.name: idx_module_projection_name
indexes.note: Module name lookup (matches master_data.modules unique constraint)

config_schema_projection.description: Local read projection of Master Data's module_config_schemas table. Synced via config-schema.declared events. Used for config validation and admin UI form rendering.

module_id.description: Module this schema belongs to. References module_projection.id.

schema_version.description: Semver version of the config schema (e.g., 1.0.0, 1.1.0)

config_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07+) describing configurable parameters. Used for validation and admin UI rendering.

defaults.description: Default config values. Served when a tenant has no explicit config for this module.

synced_at.description: When this projection was last synced from a Master Data event

indexes.name: idx_config_schema_projection_module_version
indexes.note: One schema per module per version

feature_flag_projection.description: Local read projection of Master Data's feature_flags table. Synced via feature-flag.defined and feature-flag.updated events. Used for flag resolution and admin UI.

id.description: Flag ID — matches master_data.feature_flags.id (preserved from event payload)

flag_type.description: Determines validation and UI rendering for overrides

default_value.description: Platform-wide default. Applied when no tenant override exists.

module_id.description: Module this flag belongs to (NULL = platform-wide). References module_projection.id.

value_schema.description: JSON Schema for json-type flags. Used to validate override values. Post-launch.

synced_at.description: When this projection was last synced from a Master Data event

indexes.name: idx_feature_flag_projection_name
indexes.note: Flag name lookup (matches master_data.feature_flags unique constraint)

indexes.name: idx_feature_flag_projection_module
indexes.note: List flags for a specific module

tenant_modules.description: Module enablement per tenant. This is the mechanism behind fragmented adoption — a tenant sees only its enabled modules.

module_id.description: Module being enabled/disabled. References configurator.module_projection.id (local projection of Master Data's module registry).

is_enabled.description: Current enablement state. false = module is disabled but data is retained.

is_core_override.description: True for core modules seeded during provisioning. These cannot be disabled via admin UI.

enabled_at.description: When the module was last enabled

disabled_at.description: When the module was disabled (NULL if currently enabled)

check_constraints.name: chk_core_module_always_enabled
check_constraints.note: Core modules cannot be disabled — defense-in-depth against API bypass

indexes.name: idx_tenant_modules_enabled
indexes.note: List enabled modules for a tenant (BFF route filtering, module discovery)

tenant_feature_flags.description: Per-tenant feature flag overrides. If no row exists for a flag+tenant, the platform default from feature_flags.default_value applies.

feature_flag_id.description: Flag being overridden. References configurator.feature_flag_projection.id (local projection of Master Data's feature flag registry).

value.description: Tenant-specific override value. Type depends on feature_flags.flag_type.

is_enabled.description: Whether this override is active. false = tenant falls back to platform default.

indexes.name: idx_tenant_feature_flags_enabled
indexes.note: List active overrides for a tenant

tenant_module_configs.description: Actual configuration values per tenant per module. config_values JSONB is validated against module_config_schemas.config_schema.

module_id.description: Module this config applies to. References configurator.module_projection.id (local projection of Master Data's module registry).

config_values.description: Configuration values for this module in this tenant. Validated against the module's declared config_schema.

schema_version.description: Which config schema version these values target. Used for migration validation when a module upgrades its schema.

etag.description: Content hash for conditional GETs (If-None-Match). Regenerated on every config update. Enables efficient polling without full-payload transfers.

created_by.description: Admin who created the initial configuration for this module in this tenant

updated_by.description: Admin who last modified this configuration

integration_profiles.description: External system connections per tenant. Defines how a tenant connects to lab analyzers, ABDM, PACS, insurance systems, legacy HIS.

target_system.description: External system identifier (e.g., cobas-6000, abdm, dcm4chee, tpa-clearinghouse)

protocol.description: Integration protocol family. Version is in protocol_version. Matches the inter-module communication hierarchy from HLD-03 §7.

protocol_version.description: Specific version of the protocol the external system supports. FHIR: '4.0.1' (R4), '3.0.2' (STU3), '5.0.0' (R5). HL7v2: '2.3', '2.5', '2.5.1'. REST/custom: API version (e.g., 'v2'). NULL = not yet determined.

direction.description: Data flow direction. inbound = external pushes to platform. outbound = platform pushes to external.

connection_config.description: Endpoint URLs, timeouts, retry config, TLS settings. NOT credentials — those are in the vault.

credential_vault_ref.description: Reference to the credential in the platform's secret store (e.g., Azure Key Vault path). Never store credentials directly.

mapping_rules.description: Transformation and mapping rules consumed by the Integration Hub's transformation engine.

is_active.description: Whether this integration is currently active. Deactivating preserves the config for re-activation.

created_by.description: Admin who created this integration profile

indexes.name: idx_integration_profiles_protocol
indexes.note: Filter integrations by protocol type

indexes.name: idx_integration_profiles_active
indexes.note: List active integrations for a tenant

indexes.name: idx_integration_profiles_target
indexes.note: Look up integrations by target system

tenant_provisioning_log.description: Tracks provisioning workflow steps per tenant. Each provisioning run creates multiple step records. Provides visibility, retryability, and audit trail.

iq_tenant_id.description: Citus distribution key — the tenant being provisioned

status.description: Step execution state. pending→in_progress→completed/failed. skipped for non-applicable steps.

completed_at.description: When this step finished (whether success or failure)

error_details.description: Error message if step failed. Used for diagnostics and retry decisions.

initiated_by.description: Platform operator who triggered the provisioning workflow

indexes.name: idx_tenant_provisioning_log_status
indexes.note: Find incomplete/failed steps for retry

indexes.name: idx_tenant_provisioning_log_step
indexes.note: Check whether a specific step has been completed

config_change_audit.description: All configuration changes — who changed what, when, and why. Configurator's equivalent of User Management's permission_change_audit.

iq_tenant_id.description: Citus distribution key — the target tenant whose configuration was changed. For 'organization' entity type only: the acting admin's tenant context (since organizations have no natural tenant ID).

entity_type.description: Type of entity that was changed. Organization changes are tracked with the acting admin's tenant context.

action.description: What was done to the entity

old_value.description: State before the change (null for 'created' actions)

new_value.description: State after the change (null for some destructive actions)

reason.description: Optional justification for the change (e.g., 'Billing dispute — suspended per ticket #1234')

changed_by.description: Admin who made the change (from JWT sub claim)

indexes.name: idx_config_change_audit_type
indexes.note: Filter audit by entity type

indexes.name: idx_config_change_audit_entity
indexes.note: All changes to a specific entity

indexes.name: idx_config_change_audit_time
indexes.note: Chronological audit trail per tenant

indexes.name: idx_config_change_audit_actor
indexes.note: All changes made by a specific admin
